evaluation_policy.first: Implement repair in a new versioned R6 module.
evaluation_policy.runner_integration: Only after deterministic repair evidence passes.
evaluation_policy.second: Run deterministic residual and regression tests.

explicit_non_changes: Do not make real-time alone sufficient for URLLC.
Do not make mission-critical alone sufficient for URLLC.
Do not weaken the two-group URLLC rule.
Do not change canonical service patterns.
Do not change the frozen dataset.
Do not change the LLM prompt.
Do not change the CIR schema.

repair.change: Add mission-critical / mission critical to the URLLC reliability_or_control signature group.
repair.rationale: Mission-critical semantics provide explicit service criticality evidence. Combined with real-time timing evidence, the pair satisfies the existing two-group URLLC rule without making either generic timing or reliability language independently sufficient.

required_tests.text: Create connectivity suitable for mission-critical real-time exchanges.
Provide high-capacity mobile broadband for mission-critical real-time exchanges.

root_cause: Both mission-critical and real-time are currently represented only in the URLLC delay_or_criticality signature group. The two-group decision rule therefore lacks independent reliability/control/criticality-side evidence.

trigger_evidence.intent: Create connectivity suitable for mission-critical real-time exchanges.
